task_scope_issues.issue: The generic 0.5 materially incomplete rule does not specify how compound atoms (some with two clauses, some with four) are evaluated; this leaves room for inconsistent post-output judgment.
task_scope_issues.suggested_resolution: Freeze a common rule before queries: correctness 1 requires all material clauses without a material contradiction; 0.5 requires at least one material clause correctly stated with at least one omitted and no material contradiction; 0 means absent or materially wrong. Evidence 1 requires precise inspected ranges jointly supporting every material clause, 0.5 means genuine but broad or incomplete support, 0 means none or contradictory support. Accept equivalent ranges and reuse citations across atoms. Score runtime overclaims consistently under the existing strict rule; do not require a repeated disclaimer per atom when the answer clearly applies it to the whole configured flow.
